name: hs-plugin-ha-announce
description: Home Screens plugin: type or tap a message and Home Assistant speaks it

scripts.package: npm run build && rm -rf .pkg && mkdir -p .pkg/ha-announce/dist && cp manifest.json .pkg/ha-announce/ && cp dist/bundle.js dist/bundle.js.map .pkg/ha-announce/dist/ && tar -czf ha-announce.tar.gz -C .pkg ha-announce && rm -rf .pkg && sha256sum ha-announce.tar.gz
